definition.def: Your occupation is your job or profession.
examples: I suppose I was looking for an occupation which was going to be an adventure.

definition.def: An occupation is something that you spend time doing, either for pleasure or because it needs to be done.
The occupation of a country happens when it is entered and controlled by a foreign army.
examples: Prii had become fluent in German during the Wehrmacht's occupation of Estonia in 1942.
...the deportation of Jews from Paris during the German occupation.

definition.def: The occupation of a building is the act or fact of someone living or working in it.
examples: ...people who sell their home and buy another one for their own occupation.
